adaptation: Renamed the preload for Pocket Harness; added compile-time forced-EPERM, copy-error and interrupted-copy test paths; bounded both independent hard-link fallback copies and /proc/self/fd dlopen copies to 1 GiB including source growth during reads; verified source inode and metadata against replacement or mutation; and published regular-file copies through a same-directory fsync plus renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), so failed or interrupted copies never expose a partial target. Hard-link copies are independent files and do not preserve shared-inode semantics; process termination may leave a hidden temporary copy.
